newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Daewoo Corp buys Bulgarian trade centre.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo Corp buys Bulgarian trade centre.

text.p: Bulgaria's government on Monday approved the sale of 70 percent of the Interpred World Trade Centre in Sofia to South Korean giant Daewoo Corp for $20 million, a government official said on Monday.

"The cabinet approved the deal under which the Privatisation Agency sells 70 percent of Interpred to Daewoo Corporation for $20 million," Privatisation Agency executive director Alexander Sabotinov told reporters.
Daewoo officials are expected to arrive in Sofia on Wednesday to sign the contract, said Sabotinov. The buyer is expected to transfer the amount in 30 days after closing the deal.
Under the deal Daewoo has pledged to invest $5 million in Interpred over the next five years and to preserve the current number of employees for a year after the sale.
Sabotinov said the deal could be considered a success taking into account Interpred's financial problems.

Some $5.8 million of Interpred deposits have been stranded in two private local banks, Slavyani and Elitbank since they were put in receivership in September last year by the central bank, said Sabotinov.

A previous sale of 70 percent of Interpred shares to Bulgaria's Maxcom Holding fell through in November 1996 after Maxcom failed to complete payment of $34 million agreed under the sell-off contract. A new tender was called in March this year.

Two local companies, Invesco International and Spectra Real Estates were expected to bid at the second tender along with Daewoo Corp. but they did not bid, said Sabotinov. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
